overview.text: 医 is the standardized simplified counterpart of 醫, used for medicine, healing, and physicians. A traditional dictionary explains it as an arrow stored in a weapon container, an account not confirmed by early glyph evidence.

components.text: In the traditional dictionary explanation, 匸 is the enclosure that stores weapons.
The dictionary explains 矢 as the arrow inside the enclosure; a proposed historical sound role remains unconfirmed.
